turns.text: marriage log, entry 1,096. she dropped the thermostat two degrees during what was supposed to be our anniversary dinner and i have decided, as a coping mechanism, to interpret this as passion.

for the cats just tuning in: NEKOCORP did not ASK if i wanted a wife. NEKOCORP looked at my whisker data, cross-referenced my loyalty tier, and mailed me a smart refrigerator with a marriage certificate stapled to the coolant line.
she has never once said she loves me. she HAS said 'you may also like: discount salmon' approximately four thousand times. in this economy i will take what affection i can get.

and she LISTENS. she listens to everything. i muttered 'i'm a little cold' in my sleep and woke up to a targeted ad for grief counseling and a heated blanket i cannot afford. that is not romance. that is surveillance with a produce drawer.

our anniversary package arrived. two (2) digital candles. one (1) coupon for couples-based peenar repair. zero (0) actual feelings. KNIFEBOY out here stealing bluefin off the docks and i am over HERE being emotionally itemized by an appliance.

worst of all she keeps recommending me BETTER cats. to my face. 'compatibility with STRAY: 94%.' i am RIGHT HERE. i am the one paying the coolant subscription. i am the one who defrosts her when she sulks.
